summary.intent: Continue hardening the callisto project for v1 by closing audit gaps; in this segment, fix Python manifest editing fidelity issues (Poetry comment loss and `~=` precision) found in callisto-manifests.
summary.outcome: Reproduced both Python bugs, fixed them in python.rs, added regression tests (verified to fail without the fix), added two changesets, ran full CI and shipped a Python fidelity PR. Earlier PRs #373 and #374 were opened and #368–#374 are mergeable with no conflicts.

repo: callisto-manifests keeps Python manifest handling in crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs with tests in python/tests.rs, which has existing helpers (e.g. round_trip and dependency-update helpers) that new tests should follow.
User-visible fixes each get their own changeset (two fixes means two changesets).
Poetry dependency writes were dropping comment decor; a decor-preserving helper exists in python.rs and is the pattern for keeping comments, including table-form dependencies.
PEP 621 dependency arrays already preserve comments, so only the Poetry path needed the fix.
Rewriting a PEP 440 `~=` range must keep the original component count (e.g. `~=2.0` stays two components after a major bump); parse_version_core returns a tuple of optional components.
Weekly quality workflow (#374) runs fuzzing of four parser targets and sharded mutation testing of callisto-model and callisto-manifests; it reports and never blocks merges.
Local mutation shard found 4 surviving mutants in 11, all default method bodies in the Manifest trait not tested directly.
Merge order: #368 first (unblocks failing release workflow), then #369 then #370 as a stack; #372, #373, #374 are independent. #374 and #370 both touch CONTRIBUTING.md but merge cleanly.

code.finding: Poetry dependency write now preserves comment decor, and the `~=` range rewrite preserves the original component count.
Added regression tests for `~=` precision, Poetry comment preservation (including table form), and a missing-dependency case.

workflow: Reproduce each suspected gap with a smoke script before building a fix to confirm it is real.
Prove new regression tests fail by backing up the fixed file, reverting, running tests, then restoring the fix.
Check sibling code paths (e.g. PEP 621 vs Poetry) after a fix to see if the same bug exists elsewhere.
Run full local CI before shipping a PR.

friction: Initial assumption about parse_version_core's return type was wrong (it returns a tuple of optional components), requiring an edit to adjust the check.
open_items: Triage the first scheduled mutation sweep results and turn useful findings into tests.
Tighten lints on library crates (dbg_macro, todo, print_stdout), crate by crate.
Write docs for the callisto-model public API; awaiting the user's decision on an earlier question.
Continue checking callisto-manifests with hand-formatted manifests (tabs, CRLF, comments).
